questions.stem: During your community medicine rotation in a rural setting, you engage in discussions with the local medical officer about the assessment of malnutrition in children. After reviewing various parameters used to diagnose malnutrition, the medical officer poses a question about which indicator can be used independently of a child's age. Which of the following would you identify as an age-independent indicator of malnutrition?
